items.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
items.description: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to potentially cause the appliance to make requests to unintended location.

priority.reason: Confirmed exploited (CISA KEV). Known ransomware campaign use. EPSS 74% probability of exploitation within 30 days. CVSS v3 base score 10.0.

w5h.upgrade_action: Apply current vendor patches for SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances per the advisory (CISA remediation due date: 2026-07-17)
w5h.why_it_matters: This matters because exploitation is confirmed or actively occurring, not theoretical; EPSS puts exploitation probability at 74% within 30 days; critical severity means full compromise is likely if reached.

impact.affected_versions: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances (specific versions not provided, assume all vulnerable until vendor clarifies)
impact.how_to_check: Inventory all SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances installations and compare versions against the advisory. Review logs on matching hosts for unusual authentication or administrative actions.
